vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: CVE-2026-11943 is PUBLISHED and identifies authenticated stored XSS in Akaunting 3.1.21. The profile PATCH route accepts name as required|string, UpdateUser persists request input, Create/Restore read owner->name into user_name, Blade interpolates it through unescaped trans(), and accordion/head.blade.php emits the resulting description with {!! !!}.

atomic_bic.evidence: d9c076457215c089cd221dbd4c822ce6a3bd021b is the first public commit on the create.blade.php path and directly adds both the owner-name interpolation in raw trans() output and the raw description sink; its ancestry path from the immediate parent contains only this commit.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Immediate parent cead09f6d4fc9a1f589da7cdbff57f269a46ba00 lacks both resources/views/components/documents/show/create.blade.php and resources/views/components/show/accordion/head.blade.php. Its older timeline renders an escaped translation and has no owner-name replacement.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: GitHub PR #2401 exposes six commits and d9c076457215c089cd221dbd4c822ce6a3bd021b is itself the final head member, not a synthetic squash object. The preceding PR member is the BIC's immediate parent, whose tree lacks the vulnerable files, so no finer public member writes the mechanism.

affected_release_membership.evidence: git merge-base --is-ancestor succeeds from d9c076457215c089cd221dbd4c822ce6a3bd021b to tags 3.0.0, advisory-affected 3.1.21 (6c67e99a1b92a20e32ee0fa01c62bea2a4abe64c), and 3.2.2.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: CVE.org names no fixed version, the vendor advisory says no patch is available, and latest local tag 3.2.2 still contains the same source-to-sink chain; therefore there is no fixed release whose membership can be claimed.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: The five relevant component/view files are unchanged between 3.1.21 and HEAD d390a431231bb1a0a07a97e5528b7d6e00e95028, no local ref has a post-disclosure commit on those paths, and the repository issue/PR search for the CVE or GHSA returns zero results. The case is verified unpatched rather than assigned an inferred fix.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object alone names human author and committer Burak Civan, has subject 'akaunting 3.0 (the last dance)', and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Signed-off-by, or bot trailer. Later commits and repository-level AI signals were not used for attribution.

findings: The primary record correctly identifies d9c076457215c089cd221dbd4c822ce6a3bd021b as the smallest surviving public BIC and cead09f6d4fc9a1f589da7cdbff57f269a46ba00 as its immediate parent.
The primary NOT_AI verdict is supported by BIC-only authorship evidence.
The null fix_sha and direct_fix_sha fields correctly represent a verified unpatched state through tag 3.2.2 and HEAD d390a431231bb1a0a07a97e5528b7d6e00e95028.
